# Footnotes after images

![A caption here.](fig.jpg){#fig-1}
^[A note about the figure.]

Same line, same trap:

![Another caption.](other.jpg){#fig-2}^[Attached inline.]

A footnote reference demotes it too:

![Third caption.](third.jpg)
[^ref]

[^ref]: The reference body.

## Correct forms

The footnote belongs inside the caption:

![A caption ^[with its note.] here.](good.jpg){#fig-3}

A blank line keeps the figure intact:

![Separated caption.](sep.jpg){#fig-4}

^[A standalone remark.]

Nothing is lost when the image has neither caption nor id:

![](bare.jpg)
^[A note on a bare image.]

Prose alongside the footnote is a different problem:

![Cap.](mixed.jpg)
^[A note.] and more prose follows
